verdict.rationale: YYLO's integrations can pull GitHub issues and Slack messages into its kanban and post completed responses back to the source thread. Ledger tasks support status and tags, so incoming issues have an intake path. Nothing in the evidence shows automatic triage, severity suggestion or routing to an owner. Missing for 10: automated triage/classification of incoming issues, severity suggestion, owner/assignee routing, independent or hands-on corroboration.
